rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Portainer MCP Server provides a bridge between AI assistants and Portainer container management platform through a Go implementation. The server exposes tools for managing environments, stacks, teams, users, and tags, while also offering Docker and Kubernetes API proxying capabilities. Built with strict version compatibility checks and an optional read-only mode for enhanced security, it enables AI assistants to interact with containerized infrastructure for use cases such as environment monitoring, access control management, and stack deployment. The implementation embeds tool definitions in the binary while supporting external configuration, making it flexible for both standard and customized deployments.
